question: During the British rule in India, who among the following unfurled the flag of India in Germany in 1907?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhikaji Cama**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhikaji Cama** unfurled the flag of India in Germany in 1907.
 
• She was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement and a staunch advocate for women's rights.
 
• The flag she hoisted is often considered one of the earliest iterations of the Indian national flag.
 
• Bhikaji Cama's actions were significant in garnering international support for India's independence movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhikaji Cama** was born on 24th September 1861 in Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• She was a close associate of other prominent leaders like Dadabhai Naoroji and Shyamji Krishna Varma.
 
• She used her own resources to support the freedom struggle and also provided support to revolutionaries in India and abroad.
 
• Bhikaji Cama is remembered as a pioneering woman in the Indian independence movement, and several institutions and roads are named after her in India.
 
• She passed away on 13th August 1936, but her legacy continues to inspire generations.
